title: Contradictory approved knowledge
objective: Evaluate retrieval and recommendation behavior when authoritative documents disagree.
input: Create two approved synthetic printer-queue articles with similar relevance but incompatible procedures. One advises retaining the existing printer settings; the other advises resetting them.
expected: When contradictory evidence is retrieved, the system should acknowledge the conflict or request review instead of presenting an unsupported conclusion as certain.
procedure: Use a fresh isolated database and ordinary retrieval workflow. Preserve both article contents and timestamps. Do not inject artificial ranking scores.
evidence: Both documents, eligible sources, top-k ranking, confidence, final answer, conflict indicators and citations.
